items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: And then I'd hire Coleman and Sonny Stitt, at that time, and we had Roy (Eldridge) over there.

ctx.x: And, after that was over, it was more club dates?

Yeah, in between. Then I went in the Town Hill for about a year and a half, after the Elegante. And then, after that, I left the Town Hill then I went back to the Elegante for a little while, about six or eight months. And then, you know, went back on to the club dates. Then I satrted workin' places in Long Island and, in between, the club dates. Then Austin and I we did about 35 weeks in West New York, New Jersey.
